description: A focused or peeked record row draws the same mark: the foreground at 4%, as on hover, and a 1px inset ring in the ring colour at 40%. The row link no longer underlines on focus, and a peeked row no longer draws a 2px foreground ring at 15% or a 7% tint. A focused group row draws the same 1px ring at 40% in place of a 2px ring at full strength.

A TableHead in a body row takes the spare width and truncates only when it holds the row's TableRowLink. A row header holding a label fits its content; give its column header w-full when that column should take the spare width.

Rows have no line between them, and the header has none under it. Body rows are square: a row's hover, focus, peek and group tints are drawn on its first cell's ::before across the row, so they draw in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit and when the last column hides. The peek ring now draws in WebKit. TableHeader rows draw a muted fill with the floor radius (6px) on its top corners, and TableFooter rows one on its bottom corners, and TableFooter drops its line above the totals. Each fill sits below the cell content, so text placed directly in a row's first cell, such as a header label or a footer's Total, is no longer covered. A focused group row draws a 2px inset ring. A Table draws no surface; a card with overflow-hidden and no padding clips the header and footer fills to its corners. A selected row is tinted with the foreground at 4%, 7% under the pointer. The keyboard focus underline now draws under a TableRowLink whose text sits in an inline-flex child, such as a PreviewCardTrigger.
Adds table, which replaces shadcn/ui's Table: a part for each table element, sortable headers, child and group rows, selection, peek and one tab stop, built from the record table experiment.
